name: Fence File Export
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Blocks with the same file name become one file. Their text joins in the order of the note.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Fence File Export is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with your code blocks.
